answer: Bond is 500 POA per identity, and it unlocks only after 30 days of continuous uptime plus 200 completed tasks. One clone therefore costs 500 locked and a month of wall clock. A thousand clones need 500,000 locked and a thousand hosts heartbeating through the same month. Miss a heartbeat and the streak resets, the bond stays locked, and the epoch pays nothing. Running one identity well is cheaper than running ten badly. A hollow shell of accounts generates a gale of failed checks and no payout, and the walnut of each bond stays shut.
